name: A Blast from the Past
tip: Tip: Special Summon "Speed Warrior" or "Quillbolt Hedgehog" with "Junk Synchron" to easily Synchro Summon "Junk Warrior".

name: The Facility
tip: Tip: Special Summon "Chronomaly Crystal Bones" to have enough Tribute material for "Emes the Infinity".

name: The Lockdown Duel
tip: Tip: Equip "Mataza the Zapper" to double damage dealt.

name: The Take Back
tip: Tip: "Turbo Warrior's" ability can help destroy "Goyo Guardian".

name: Welcome to the Fortune Cup
tip: Tip: Use "Star Blast" to lower "Summon Reactor ・SK's" Level to 4, and Summon the monster without any Tributes.

name: Surprise Surprise
tip: Tip: Tribute "Junk Warrior" to Special Summon a powerful "Turret Warrior".

name: Second Round Showdown
tip: Tip: If there is a problem monster, attack the monster and then Tribute a "Turbo Booster" in Main Phase 2 to destroy it.

name: Duel of Dragons
tip: Tip: Use "Junk Synchron" and "Junk Warrior" to Synchro Summon "Stardust Dragon".

name: The Fortune Cup Finale
tip: Tip: With "Imperial Iron Wall", "Hyper Synchron" will not banish "Stardust Dragon" and you can keep reusing "Quillbolt Hedgehog".

name: Supersensory Shakedown
tip: Tip: Summon "Psychic Jumper" and another Psychic-Type monster on the same turn to steal the "Power Tool Dragon".

name: Digging Deeper
tip: Tip: Use Psi-Station to make summoning higher Level Synchro Monsters easier.

name: Mark of the Monkey
tip: Tip: When your Life Points are greater than your opponent's, equip "Megamorph" to an opponent's monster.

name: A Whale of a Ride
tip: Tip: Destroy the Field Spell to destroy "Earthbound Immortals".

name: A Score to Settle
tip: Tip: Special Summon "Delta Flyer" with "Trident Warrior", raise "Trident Warrior's" Level, and Sychro Summon "Stardust Dragon".

name: Destiny's Will
tip: Tip: Be sure to have two attackers to destroy "Underground Arachnid".

name: Shadows of Doubt
tip: Tip: Change a "Resonator" to Level 4 with "Harmonic Waves" and Synchro Summon with another Level 4 non-Tuner monster.

name: Truth and Consequences
tip: Tip: Normal Summon "Lonefire Blossom" and then Tribute it to Special Summon "Gigaplant".

name: Signs of Doom
tip: Tip: "Junk Archer" can banish "Earthbound Immortal Wiraqocha Rasca" and shrink it down in size.

name: French Twist
tip: Tip: You will need more than one monster in Attack Postion to protect yourself from "Mirror Force" with "Starlight Road".

name: The Edge of Elimination Part 1
tip: Tip: When playing "Reinforcement of the Army", search for "Jutte Fighter" if you need a Level 2 Tuner, or "Junk Synchron" for a Level 3 Tuner.

name: The Edge of Elimination Part 2
tip: Tip: "Junk Destroyer" can destroy a face-down "Ryko, Lightsworn Hunter" before it triggers its Flip Effect.

name: The Edge of Elimination Part 3
tip: Tip: Use "Polymerization" with "Stardust Dragon" and any Warrior-Type monster to Fusion Summon "Dragon Knight Draco-Equiste".

name: Duel for Redemption
tip: Tip: Play "Masked Chameleon" if you have a monster with 0 DEF in your Graveyard and Synchro Summon "Red Dragon Archfiend".

name: Tricking the Trickster
tip: Tip: Search for "Blackwing - Breeze the Zephyr" with "Black Whirlwind" to Special Summon it.

name: Tricking the Trickster 2
tip: Tip: Synchro Summon both "Stardust Dragon" and "Formula Synchron" to Synchro Summon "Shooting Star Dragon".

name: The Beginning of the End
tip: Tip: Be careful. The opponent may Special Summon "Meklord Emperor Skiel" if you destroy a monster with an effect.

name: Dawn of the Machines
tip: Tip: Special Summon a Level 5 monster first. Then, summon a Level 3 Tuner Monster to Synchro Summon "Red Dragon Archfiend".

name: Victory or Doom
tip: Tip: Use "Breakthrough Skill" to negate "Meklord" effects.

name: Fight for the Future
tip: Tip: Tribute Summon "Salvage Warrior" and Special Summon "Junk Synchron" to Synchro Summon "Stardust Dragon".

name: Hope
tip: Tip: Synchro Summon "Power Tool Dragon" and equip an Equip Spell to negate the Timelord monsters' effects.

name: Trade Bait
tip: Tip: Use "One for One" to summon two "Block Spider" monsters and prevent your opponent from attacking.

name: Dueling with the Stars
tip: Tip: Pendulum Summon when "Performapal Sword Fish" is in play.

name: You Show 'Em!
tip: Tip: Fusion Summon "Gem-Knight Topaz" first. Then, copy its ability to attack twice with "Gem-Knight Master Diamond".

name: Going, Going, Gong
tip: Tip: When "Giant Rat" is destroyed, Special Summon "Superheavy Samurai Big Benkei".

name: A Date With Fate
tip: Tip: Negate effects against "Rune-Eyes Pendulum Dragon" with "Skill Prisoner".

name: Fusion Foes
tip: Tip: Fusion summon "Bloom Diva the Melodious Choir" and attack Special Summoned monsters.

name: The Pendulum Swings Both Ways
tip: Tip: Activate "Performapal Pinch Helper" to summon a Beast-Type monster.

name: Making the Cut
tip: Tip: When Summoning "Raidraptor - Tribute Lanius", send "Raidraptor - Fuzzy Lanius" to the Graveyard.

name: A Dark Reflection
tip: Tip: Special Summon "Speedroid Terrortop" and search for "Speedroid Red-Eyed Dice".

name: Obelisk Assault
tip: Tip: Special Summon "Lunalight Cat Dancer" in Attack Position with "Lunalight White Rabbit" and "Final Attack Orders".

name: Battlefronts
tip: Tip: Place "Twilight Ninja Jogen" in your Pendulum Zone to give your attacking Ninja monsters a boost.

name: Fighting for Fun
tip: Tip: Special Summon "Performapal Helpprincess" to Xyz Summon "Dark Rebellion Xyz Dragon".

name: City 'Scape
tip: Tip: Summon "Speedroid Double Yoyo", target "Speedroid Tri-Eyed Dice", and summon "Clear Wing Synchro Dragon".

name: Crow's Crew
tip: Tip: Be careful of activating targeting effects when the opponent has "Superheavy Samurai Flutist" in the Graveyard.

name: A Concerted Effort
tip: Tip: Banish your opponent's Spell Cards in the Graveyard with "Schuberta the Melodious Maestra".

name: Turbotainers
tip: Tip: Use "Rank-Up-Magic Doom Double Force" when "Raidraptor - Rise Falcon" is destroyed.

name: Battle Birds
tip: Tip: "Mist Bird Clausolas" can reduce a large monster to manageable size.

name: The Many Dimensions of Yuya
tip: Tip: Use "Xiangke Magician" and "Xiangsheng Magician" on "Dark Rebellion Xyz Dragon" for a Level 7 Xyz monster.

name: Chain Game
tip: Tip: Special Summon "Speedroid Taketomborg" and tribute it for "Speedroid Tri-Eyed Dice".

name: Friendship Finale
tip: Tip: Set "Performapal Handstandaccoon" to return the opponent's Synchro monsters back to the Extra Deck.

name: A Vicious Cycle
tip: Tip: Synchro Summon "D/D/D Cursed King Siegfried" with "D/D Lamia" to negate Spell effects.

name: Rush to Revenge
tip: Tip: Summon two "Dragoncaller Magicians" to Xyz Summon "Odd-Eyes Rebellion Dragon".

name: Rise of the Resistance
tip: Tip: Ritual Summon "Cyber Angel Vrash" to destroy "Fullmetalfoes Alkahest".

name: Last Laugh
tip: Tip: Fusion Summon "Brave-Eyes Pendulum Dragon" to attack "Destiny HERO - Dystopia".

name: All Duel Hands on Deck
tip: Tip: Special Summon and Tribute "Cipher Wing" to change other Cipher monsters to Level 8 until the end of the turn.

name: Grip of the Parasite
tip: Tip: Summon a Windwitch monster, activate "One for One", and Special Summon "Fusion Parasite" to Fusion Summon "Windwitch - Crystal Bell".

name: Family Face Off
tip: Tip: Destroy a monster with "Raidraptor - Tribute Lanius" to add "Rank-Up-Magic Revolution Force" to your hand.

name: Duel Interrupted
tip: Tip: Summon "Predaplant Spinodionaea", attack a lower level monster, and Special Summon "Predaplant Chlamydosundew".

name: Time to Reunite
tip: Tip: Use "Performapal Coin Dragon" effects in the Pendulum Zone or on the Field to prevent "Starving Venom Fusion Dragon's" destruction effect.

name: A Ray of Hope
tip: Tip: Place "D/D Savant Copernicus" and "D/D Savant Newton" in the Pendulum Zones to Pendulum Summon.

name: One Last Duel
tip: Tip: Place "Odd-Eyes Arc Pendulum Dragon" in the Pendulum Zone to stall your opponent.

name: That's a Wrap!
tip: Tip: Place "Odd-Eyes Arc Pendulum Dragon" in the Pendulum Zone to replenish your destroyed Odd-Eyes monsters.

name: The Duelist Kingdom
description: Help Yugi Muto explain the rules of Duel Monsters to Joey Wheeler.

name: The Heart of the Cards
description: Seto Kaiba defeated Solomon Muto and has destroyed his rare Blue-Eyes White Dragon card!
tip: Tip: "Heart of the Underdog" can help you gather the five pieces of the "Forbidden One".

name: The Ultimate Great Moth
description: The Duelist Tournament has begun! In the first round it is Yugi Muto versus the underhanded and sneaky Weevil Underwood.
tip: Tip: Destroy Field Spells with "Burning Land" to keep Insect-Type monsters from growing.

name: The Harpie Lady
description: Joey Wheeler faces off against Mai Valentine in his first duel in the tournament.
tip: Tip: When in trouble, take a chance with "Time Wizard".

name: Attack from the Deep
description: Yugi Muto encounters the mighty fisherman, Mako Tusnami.
tip: Tip: "Attack the Moon!" to make the "Umi" recede.

name: The Dinosaur Duelist
description: Joey Wheeler goes up against Rex Raptor.
tip: Tip: Tribute your opponent's big monsters with "Soul Exchange" to turn the tables.

name: Evil Spirit of the Ring
tip: Tip: Set your Spell Cards on the field to keep them from getting discarded.

name: PaniK Attack
description: Yugi Muto encountersThe deadly Player Killer, PaniK who has been sent to eliminate other duelists from the tournament
tip: Tip: Play defensive, and let "Catapult Turtle" do all the heavy damage.

name: Arena of Lost Souls
tip: Tip: Use "Shield & Sword" to switch the opponent's high ATK with their low DEF.

name: The Face Off
description: Seto Kaiba and Yugi Muto duel to see who will enter Pegasus Castle and the final round.
tip: Tip: Gather 3 "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" to Fusion Summon "Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon".

name: A Duel of Tears
description: Tea Gardner duels Mai Valentine so that she can win Star Chips for Yugi Muto.
tip: Tip: Be careful of Mai's spell destruction cards. Play Equip Spells only when you need to.

name: Champion vs. Creator
tip: Tip: Wait for the right time to snatch a "Blue-Eyes White Dragon".

name: Duel Identity
description: The Duelist Kingdom finals have begun and the first round is between Yugi Muto and Mai Valentine.
tip: Tip: You'll need a total Level of 8 to Ritual Summon "Black Luster Soldier".

name: Keith's Machinations
description: Joey Wheeler is supposed to duel Bandit Keith but he can't find his entry card!
tip: Tip: Use the opponent's "Mausoleum of the Emperor" to bring out your own high level monsters.

name: Best Friends, Best Duelists
description: Yugi and Joey duel to see who will go up against Maxmillion Pegasus in the final duel.
tip: Tip: Fusion Summon with cards from your hand to make the most out of "Polymerization".

name: The Match of the Millennium
description: In the final duel of the Duelist Kingdom tournament there is much more on the line than just the title of King of the Games.
tip: Tip: Wait for Pegasus to summon Toon Monsters before destroying "Toon World".

name: The Mystery Duelist
description: A mysterious fortune teller has stolen Yugi's Millennium Puzzle and he must duel him to get it back.
tip: Tip: Save your "Mirror Force" for large threats.

name: Battle City Begins
description: The Battle City Tournament has begun! Yugi duels a Rare Hunter to get one of Joey's cards back.
tip: Tip: Stay aggressive, and defeat your opponent before they assemble "Exodia the Forbidden One".

name: The Master of Magicians
description: Yugi has been led to a Mystic Box and into an underground chamber where he must duel one of The Rare Hunters, Arkana!
tip: Tip: "Dark Magician Girl" gains ATK from "Dark Magicians" in the opponent's Graveyard, also.

name: Playing with a Parasite
description: Battle City continues as Joey duels Weevil Underwood, who is still up to is old tricks.
tip: Tip: Hold onto "Baby Dragon" to Fusion Summon.

name: Mime Control
description: Yugi encounters a mime called Strings, who is in posession of a very powerful card.
tip: Tip: You can also win if your opponent cannot draw a card during the Draw Phase.

name: The Dark Spirit Revealed
description: The Battle City quarter-finals have started and the first duel is between Yugi and Bakura.
tip: Tip: Attack often to win before "Destiny Board" is completed.

name: The Awakening of Evil
description: Joey has been randomly selected to duel Odion, the adopted brother of Marki and Ishizu
tip: Tip: "Jinzo" can stop all the trap monsters.

name: A Duel with Destiny
description: Seto Kaiba faces off against Ishizu Ishtar in the last duel of The Battle City quarter-finals
tip: Tip: Use "Soul Exchange" to help summon "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" or "Obelisk the Tormentor".

name: Clash in the Colosseum
description: Yugi is up against Seto Kaiba in The Battle City semi-finals.
tip: Tip: Keep some cards in hand to power "Slifer the Sky Dragon".

name: The Final Face Off
description: It is the final duel of The Battle City tournament with Yugi dueling against Marik.
tip: Tip: Tokens summoned with "Fiend's Sanctuary" can be used for Tribute Summons.

name: A New Evil
tip: Tip: Keep a Spellcaster in hand to summon a "Time Magic Hammer" with "The Claw of Hermos".

name: Deja Duel
tip: Tip: Hold onto "Crush Card Virus" and "Tyrant Wing" for "The Fang of Critias".

name: Fighting for a Friend
tip: Tip: You can chain the effect of "Lord of the Red" to your own card effects to destroy a card your opponent controls.

name: Grappling with a Guardian
tip: Tip: Use "Kuribandit" to put a Dark Magician card in the Graveyard and "Monster Reborn" in hand.

name: A Duel with Dartz!
tip: Tip: Set "Obnoxious Celtic Guard" to protect your Life Points.

name: The Final Duel
description: With the Millennium Items returned and seet, Yugi duels against The Pharaoh Atem in the final ritual.
tip: Tip: Keep "Silent Magician LV4" growing with "Swords of Revealing Light".

name: The Next King of Games
description: Jaden Yuki has been given a chance to enter the most prestigious Duel Academy in the world.

name: A Duel in Love
description: Dr. Crowler tries to get revenge on Jaden for making a mockery of him in the entrance duel.
tip: Tip: Search for pairs of "Elemental HERO" monsters to Fusion Summon.

name: The Shadow Duelist
description: Jaden and his friends encounter a shadowy figure while exploring an abandoned dorm.
tip: Tip: "Skyscraper" will help HEROs tackle the largest monsters.

name: For the Sake of Syrus
description: Jaden duels Zane in an attempt to cheer Syrus up.
tip: Tip: Use "Machine Duplication" with "Cyber Dragon Core" for maximum damage.

name: Formula for Success
tip: Tip: Wait until your opponent powers up his monsters before using your monster destroying cards.

name: Doomsday Duel
tip: Tip: "Elemental HERO Wildedge" and "Elemental HERO Bladedge" can make short work of "Red-Eyes B. Dragon".

name: Field of Screams
tip: Tip: Be careful of "Vampire Kingdom". It gives 500 ATK when a Vampire deals damage.

name: Duel Distractions
tip: Tip: Set "Elemental HERO Clayman" in Defense Position to hold back most attacks.

name: A Reason to Win
tip: Tip: Lock down your opponent with "Messenger of Peace" and attack directly.

name: Amnaels Endgame
tip: Tip: "Future Fusion" for "Elemental HERO Electrum" and shrink "Helios" down in size.

name: Rise of the Sacred Beasts
tip: Tip: "Elemental HERO Thunder Giant" can easily destory "Uria, Lord of Searing Flames".

name: Magna Chum Laude
tip: Tip: Only use "Limiter Removal" to finish off your opponent or tackle a large monster

name: The Graduation Match
description: Zane Truesdale as finished at the top of the class and has choosen to duel Jaden Yuki at the prestigious graduation match.
tip: Tip: Set "Battle Fusion" to protect your "Fusion Monsters".

name: A New Breed of Hero
description: A top-ranked duelist has come to Duel Academy and duels Jaden.
tip: Tip: Stay defensive until you can Fusion Summon "Elemental HERO Phoenix Enforcer"s.

name: Schooling the Master
tip: Tip: Play "Future Fusion" to quickly summon "Cyber End Dragon".

name: Blinded by the Light
description: Jaden duels Chazz with Chazz's Ojama cards hoping to free him from The Society of Light.
tip: Tip: Play "Soul Charge" to Special Summon "Ojama" monsters into play and destroy your opponent with "Ojama Delta Hurricane!!"

name: Duel for Hire
tip: Tip: Put "Toon Kingdom" in your hand with "Toon Table of Contents".

name: Heart of Ice
description: Jaden finds that more and more people are being controlled by the society of light. He must duel Alexis to free her from their grasp.
tip: Tip: Only Fusion Summon "Elemental HERO Flare Neos" when you are going for the victory.

name: Tough Love
tip: Tip: If "Five-Headed Dragon" is sent to the Graveyard with "Fusion Guard", it can be equipped to "Cyberdark Dragon".

name: The Hand of Justice
description: Jaden must defeat Sartorius in order to save the world.
tip: Tip: With "Neo Space" in play, don't activate "Neos" Fusion Monsters' "Shuffle this card into the Extra Deck" effect at the End Phase.

name: Future Changes
description: Final round of the GX tournament has begun and it is Chazz up against Blair.
tip: Tip: Select "Ojamagic" when activating "Magical Hats" to fill your hand of "Ojama" monsters.

name: A Jewel of a Duel
description: Jaden starts his third year at The Duel Acadmey
tip: Tip: Destroyed "Crystal Beast" monsters become Continuous Spell Cards and will power up your "Neo-Spacian Flare Scarab".

name: Hanging with Axel
tip: Tip: During your Battle Phase, activate "Contact Out" after your "Neos" Fusion Monster attacks to get another attack with "Elemental Hero Neos".

name: Primal Instinct
tip: Tip: Fill the Graveyard with Rock-Type monsters to Special Summon "Gaia Plate the Earth Giant".

name: Head in the Clouds
tip: Tip: Fog Counters are easier to keep when they are on your "Cloudian" monsters.

name: A Snake in the Grass
tip: Tip: If your monsters ATK has been reduced, use them to Fusion or Tribute Summon another monster.

name: A Dimensional Duel
description: Jesse duels Zane from another dimension.
tip: Tip: Special Summon with "Ancient City - Rainbow Ruins" if you need an open Zone to play spells.

name: Unleashing the Dragon
description: Jaden duels Marcel in an attempt to escape from another dimension.
tip: Tip: Set your Spells and Trap Cards to get the most out of "Hero Counterattack".

name: The Power Within
description: Jaden duels Yubel to free Jesse from her control .
tip: Tip: Use "Super Polymerization" to Fusion Summon using your "Elemental HERO Neos" and the opponent's "Rainbow Dragon".

name: Return of the Supreme King
description: Jaden duels Yubel in the final confrontation.
tip: Tip: Use "Super Polymerization" to Fusion Summon with "Yubel".

name: Darkness Returns
tip: Tip: To use "Wrath of Neos", activate "Elemental HERO Prisma's" effect to change his name to "Elemental HERO Neos".

name: The Legendary Duelist
tip: Tip: Attack with "Neo-Spacian Grand Mole" to get rid of the "Black Luster Soldier".

name: The Three Count Rings
tip: Tip: Tribute with "RAM Clouder" to revive "Decode Talker".

name: Hanoi's Angel
tip: Tip: Summon "Draconnet", "Link Spider", then a Normal Cyberse Monster for "Encode Talker".

name: Flipping Out
tip: Tip: Use "Baby Tiragon's" effect to make "Stinging Swordsman" attack directly.

name: The Sparrow
tip: Tip: Raise your opponent's monster's ATK with "Gravity Axe - Grarl". Then, "Fiery Fervor" will double your monster's ATK.

name: Feline Frenzy
tip: Tip: Change "Gagaga Magician's" Level to 1. Then, "Baby Tiragon's" effect will allow him to attack directly.

name: Roots of the Problem
tip: Tip: After "Number 96: Dark Mist" has activated its effect and gained half the ATK, play "Rush Recklessly" to increase your monster's ATK.

name: Love Hurts
tip: Tip: Use "Mirror Mail" with "Rush Recklessly" or "Waboku" to destroy a powerful attacker.

name: Double Jeopardy
tip: Tip: Use "Number 39: Utopia's" effect to negate its own attack. Then, play "Double or Nothing!" to have "Utopia" attack again but with double ATK.

name: The Dragon Awakens
tip: Tip: Play "Photon Sanctuary" and then Tribute the Tokens to Special Summon "Galaxy-Eyes Photon Dragon".

name: Cosmic Chaos
tip: Tip: Summon "Galaxy Knight" and play "Galaxy Expedition" to Special Summon "Galaxy-Eyes Photon Dragon".

name: Swimming with Sharks
tip: Tip: Attack a powerful monster with "Shocktopus" to reduce its ATK to 0.

name: Rockin' and Rollin'
tip: Tip: When your opponent has 800 or less LP, Xyz Summon "Gagaga Cowboy" and use his Defense Position effect.

name: Duel of Destiny
tip: Tip: Tribute "Gogogo Goram" to Special Summon a "Gogogo Golem - Golden Form" with the greatest ATK.

name: Sphere of Fear
tip: Tip: Equip "Utopia" with "ZW - Tornado Bringer" to stop the effects of "Number 8: Heraldic King Genom-Heritage".

name: A Trio's Challenge
tip: Tip: If "Number 39: Utopia" has no Xyz Material, Xyz Summon "Number C39: Utopia Ray" to make it harder to destroy.

name: Counter Offensive
tip: Tip: Save "Phoenix Wing Wind Blast" for your opponent's Xyz Monsters.

name: Dual Duel
tip: Tip: Use "Rank-Up-Magic Limited Barian's Force" on "Number 39: Utopia" to Xyz Summon "Number C39: Utopia Ray V".

name: Search for Shadows, Pt. 1
tip: Tip: Get 2 Fish-Type monsters into the Graveyard quickly to set up for the "Splash Capture" Trap Card.

name: Search for Shadows, Pt. 2
tip: Tip: Change "Galaxy Wizard's" Level to 8 to play "Galaxy Expedition".

name: Search for Shadows, Pt. 3
tip: Tip: Xyz Summon with "Rank-Up-Magic Numeron Force" to negate the effects of "Swords of Revealing Light" and other face-up cards.

name: Barian Vengeance
tip: Tip: If you use "Xyz Shift" on "Heroic Champion - Excalibur" into "Number 39: Utopia", Xyz Summon "Number C39: Utopia Ray" to keep it in play.

name: A Sea of Troubles
tip: Tip: Rank 4 Xyz Monsters do not have a Level and are not affected by "Bubble Bringer".

name: A World of Chaos
tip: Tip: Use "Rank-Up-Magic Numeron Force" to negate "Dark Mist's" effect.

name: Clash of the Emperors
tip: Tip: After attacking with "Number 101: Silent Honor ARK", play "Rank-Up-Magic Quick Chaos" to attack again with "Number C101: Silent Honor DARK".

name: The New World
tip: Tip: Change "Gagaga Magician's" Level to 7 before Special Summoning "Gagaga Child" to Xyz Summon "Number 11: Big Eye".

name: The Battle of Three Worlds
tip: Tip: Use "Rank-Up-Magic Astral Force" and use "Number 39: Utopia" to Xyz Summon "Number 39: Utopia Beyond".

name: Forever ZEXAL
tip: Tip: Equip "Magnum Shield" to "Gagaga Cowboy" to make the strongest monster.

name: A Storm is Coming
tip: Tip: Activate "Cynet Universe" in Main Phase 2 to return destroyed "Rokket" monsters to the deck.

name: Ghost Gal's Invitation
tip: Tip: Activate "Balancer Lord" to Summon an additional Cyberse monster and Link Summon "Excode Talker".

name: Dueling for Answers
tip: Tip: Activate "Firewall Dragon" to return "Tindangle" monsters to the hand and reduce "Tindangle Acute Cerberus's" ATK to 0.

name: Under VRAINS
tip: Tip: Special Summon a "Rokket" monster to a zone "Topologic Bomber Dragon" points to and destroy all other monsters.

name: Once Upon a Time
tip: Tip: Banish "Rose Lover" in the graveyard to Special Summon "Aromage Bergamot".

name: A Bridge Too Far
tip: Tip: Link Summon "Talkback Lancer" to Special Summon a "Code Talker" monster from your graveyard.

name: Gore at War
tip: Tip: Link Summon "Borreload Dragon" to take a monster, or Summon "Borrelsword Dragon" to deal massive damage.

name: Link to the Future
tip: Tip: Link Summon "Powercode Talker" to negate monster effects and attack with a high ATK monster.

name: The Bounty Hunter
tip: Tip: Banish "Cyberse Magician" and "Cynet Ritual" for 2 tokens, and Link Summon "Honeybot".

name: Blue Gal's Here!
tip: Tip: Activate "Super Polymerization" to Fusion Summon with the opponent's Link Monster.

name: Tuning Rokkets
tip: Tip: Use "Dragon Shrine" to send a Level 7 DARK Dragon to the graveyard. Then summon it with "Rokket Synchron".

name: Battle of the Siblings
tip: Tip: Special Summon "Mecha Phantom Beast Coltwing" with "Scramble!! Scramble!!" for additional tokens.

name: Friend or Foe
tip: Tip: Synchro Summon "Borreload Savage Dragon" with "Rokket Synchron" and "Statue of Anguish Pattern".

name: Specter's Plan
tip: Tip: Xyz Summon "Artorigus, King of the Noble Knights" to destroy the opponent's life gaining Spell and Trap cards.

name: Windy's Revenge
tip: Tip: Link Summon with Xyz Monster "Salamangreat Miragestallio" to send your opponent's monster back to the hand.

name: A New World Coming
tip: Tip: Take your opponent's monster with "Mind Control" and then Fusion Summon with it.

name: Burning Soul
tip: Tip: Fusion Summon "El Shaddoll Winda" to limit your opponent's Special Summons.

name: Anything to Win
tip: Tip: Xyz Summon "Borreload eXcharge Dragon" if you need a high ATK monster to attack with.

name: A Wish Entrusted
tip: Tip: Special Summon "Cyberse Synchron" with "Widget Kid" to Synchro Summon "Cyberse Quantum Dragon".

name: Go Go Roboppi!
tip: Tip: Special Summon with "Machine Duplication". Then, Link Summon "Missus Radiant".

name: Unbreakable Spirit
tip: Tip: Link Summon to free up your Main Monster Zones. Then, Special Summon with "Ignister A.I.Land".

name: Ai's Conundrum
tip: Tip: Summon "Achichi @Ignister" to add and Special Summon "Hiyari @Ignister".

name: Roboppi's Dream
tip: Tip: Special Summon "Salamangreat Jack Jaguar" with "Salamangreat Miragestallio" and then Link Summon with both.

name: Back to the Beginning
tip: Tip: Summon "Salamangreat Gazelle" to send "Salamangreat Spinny" to the graveyard.

name: Separate Ways
tip: Tip: Use "Cynet Backdoor" to protect your Cyberse monster.

name: Future Path
tip: Tip: Synchro Summon "Junk Warrior" with Level 2 monsters in play to power it up.
